# Get Levrg

> Get Levrg provides dedicated, managed teams for businesses that need more output
> without the cost and delay of hiring in-house: video editing, social media
> management, CRM/RevOps optimization, and outbound/LinkedIn programs. Teams launch
> in about 14 days, work is billed without long-term contracts, and typical savings
> versus a North American in-house hire run up to 80%.

## Services

- [Video Editing](https://gl-vite-lp.vercel.app/video): Managed video editing teams for agencies, marketing teams, and B2B companies — short-form, long-form, motion graphics, and white-label editing.
- [Social Media Management](https://gl-vite-lp.vercel.app/social): Dedicated social media production and management teams for professional services and B2B companies.
- [CRM Optimization](https://gl-vite-lp.vercel.app/crm): HubSpot/CRM cleanup, data hygiene, and revenue-operations support.
- [Website Optimization](https://gl-vite-lp.vercel.app/website-optimization): Conversion and performance optimization for existing marketing websites.
- [LinkedIn & Outbound](https://gl-vite-lp.vercel.app/linkedin-outbound): LinkedIn-led outbound programs for B2B pipeline generation.

## Notes

- This is a client-rendered single-page app; each link above is a distinct landing
  page reached via its own URL path, served client-side via React Router.
